8,032 likes, 1,033 comments - shivesh17 on October 9, 2026: "Episode 4 of I Need to Try This💁🏻‍♂️, where I try the viral desserts taking over the internet 👀Today, we’re making EGGLESS CHOCOLATE CRÉMEUX 🍫🤎 Rich, silky, super creamy and everything a chocolate lover could dream of 🥹And trust me, this one is SO GOOD🤌🏻

1 cup milk
6tbsp sugar
2tbsp corn flour 
3cups cream
1/4 cup butter(55g)
600 grams Chocolate

Method-
1. Take a heavy bottomed pan and place it over medium heat.
2. ⁠Add in milk,sugar,cornflour, cream and butter.
3. ⁠Keep whisking the mixture till everything combines and comes to a boil. Let it slightly thicken.
4. ⁠Once done, pour the hot mixture over chopped chocolate and mix it well. The chocolate will melt from the heat and you will achieve a silky smooth mixture.
5. ⁠Pour it into the container and surface wrap it properly.Refrigerate overnight.
6. ⁠Once set use it to frost or fill your cakes.

Recreating: @mattadlard
